title: Catalog and goods line choices
decision: A column catalog_item.merged_into records which item a learned item was merged into; names are unique in a shop after normalization, hidden ones included; a typed price never rewrites the catalog price; units are normalized to a short list or kept as typed; prices are 1 to 100 000 000 UZS; a sale has 1 to 50 lines; a quantity has at most three decimals; with lines the amount may be omitted; a catalog item of another shop is answered like an unknown one; in limited mode an itemized new sale is refused and lines may still be added to an earlier sale
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull requests 20 and 26
rationale: Without the column a merge could not be told from a dismissal, so the same spelling typed again would point at the hidden duplicate. The other choices keep a saved line independent of later catalog changes (INV-17)
